headline: Abhilasha Ghumelia resigns as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of GVP Infotech
hook: Key compliance officer exits GVP Infotech
summary: GVP Infotech Limited has formally notified the stock exchange that Ms. Abhilasha Ghumelia is stepping down from her role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Her resignation becomes effective on October 31, 2026. Retail investors should note that changes in key managerial personnel are procedural corporate updates that typically have negligible impact on share price performance.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with no material impact on operations.
